rationale: Pre-registered BEFORE any IP-18 training data or local model exists, so success is measured against a fixed bar and goalposts cannot move after seeing results (survey CUSTOM_MODEL_INTEGRATION_SURVEY.md §6; T-H11 driver notes). Evaluated only on the FROZEN corpus split (dataset hash in spec.json).

pre_registered_frontier_target.note: The frontier path must auto-fix >=70% of corruption-corpus failures (rebuild passes AND unaffected bodies compare >=99.5%) with ZERO fixes that alter unaffected geometry. Set before data; do not move after.

migration_gate.description: Ship the local (Qwen3-4B, P13) IP-18 model in place of the frontier path ONLY if ALL of the following hold on the frozen bench. Otherwise keep routing to frontier (kill-switch rule).

criteria.why: At under 1/50th of frontier cost (the economic reason to migrate).
Kill-switch rule: never ship below the deterministic dangling-ref-suggestion baseline.
Same zero-tolerance bar as the frontier: no fix may alter unaffected geometry.

migration_gate.human_gate: Even when all four pass, promotion is human-signed-off per the T-H9 shadow-mode policy (verifier-score + accept-rate over N real jobs + Erik sign-off). This gate is necessary, not sufficient.

data: harvested IP-18 correction traces (real failure->accepted-fix, logged via T-H7 LoggingProvider at insertion_point IP-18)
training_recipe.objective: SFT on (corpus + traces), then GRPO with the binary rebuild-passes reward = tools.flywheel.bench.benches.regen_fix.verify_fix (rebuild AND compare_parts >=99.5% vs known-good; a rebuild-but-drift fix earns 0).
training_recipe.note: This whole block is a LATER phase. T-H11 ships the frontier path + logging seam ONLY; no local model is trained or wired in this task.
